lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: The 4am message. I have had three calls about it this morning. The polling station opens at 7am. The EC logo on the real notices has the Sinha on the left and a reference number in the footer. That notice had neither. A detail. But details are the point.

lines.prompt: Is there anything you want to report?

choices.label: Report campaign posters on the Grama Sevaka Office wall.
